blocks.h: What strategic branding does for you

items.p: We define what makes you different, then give it a name, a look and a voice that nobody else can use.
People return to brands they recognise and trust. A consistent system makes that recognition effortless.
Clear visual rules make your website, social media and ads feel like one coherent brand.

items.p: Interviews and research reveal your audience, competitors and ambitions.

blocks.h: Why businesses choose Pixelbrahma as their branding agency

faq.q: What is branding?
faq.a: Branding is how a business is recognised and remembered: its name, logo, visual style, tone of voice and every customer experience that reflects them.

faq.q: Where should a new brand start?
faq.a: Usually with positioning and a logo, followed by the materials you will use first, such as packaging, brochures or signage.

faq.q: Can you refresh an existing brand?
faq.a: Yes. We audit what already works, keep the equity you have built and update what feels dated.

faq.q: Do you handle printing?
faq.a: We prepare production-ready artwork and can coordinate with printers. <!-- TODO: confirm whether Pixelbrahma manages print production -->

faq.q: How much does a branding project cost?
faq.a: A branding project can be as small as a logo or as large as a complete identity with packaging, print and signage. We quote after a discovery call and put the scope in writing.

faq.q: What is included in a brand identity package?
faq.a: Typically a logo with its variations, colour palette, typography, usage guidelines and the first set of applications such as stationery, social templates or packaging.

faq.q: Do you offer branding services in Bengaluru and Kochi?
faq.a: Yes. We work with start-ups and established companies in India and Canada, and can support print production and installation in each market.

faq.q: How long does a branding project take?
faq.a: A logo can take a few weeks, a full identity usually takes longer. We agree a timeline at the start with review points after research, concepts and refinement.

items.h1: Outdoor branding built to be understood in three seconds
items.answer: Outdoor branding is advertising seen from the street, such as hoardings, banners, vehicle wraps and building signs. Pixelbrahma designs these with large type, strong contrast and one message, because passers-by only give you moments.

approach.p: We note how far and how fast people will see the display.
Words are trimmed to the few that matter most.
We test legibility at real size and in daylight and night conditions.

faq.q: How much text should a hoarding contain?
faq.a: As little as possible. A strong image, a short headline and one contact detail usually work best.

faq.q: Can you design vehicle branding?

faq.q: Do you book the advertising space?

faq.q: What outdoor advertising do you design?
faq.a: Hoardings, unipoles, banners, wall graphics, bus and vehicle branding, kiosks and event signage.

faq.q: How do you make a hoarding readable at a distance?
faq.a: We use few words, strong contrast, large type and one clear message, and check the layout at the viewing distance it will be seen from.

faq.q: Can you design for different hoarding sizes?
faq.a: Yes. We adapt one idea to the different sizes and ratios you need, and provide files at the right resolution for each printer.

items.h1: TVCs that tell your brand's story in thirty seconds
items.answer: A TVC, or television commercial, is a short film that promotes your brand to a broad audience on broadcast or digital screens. Pixelbrahma develops the idea, writes the script and guides production so the final film feels like your brand, not a stock ad.
includes: Cut-downs for TV, YouTube and social

approach.p: We distil one memorable idea from your brand and audience.
The story is written and visualised frame by frame for your approval.
We coordinate casting, locations, filming and editing.
Master files plus shorter versions are prepared for each channel.

uses: Brands launching a product or campaign
Businesses repurposing TV ads for online video

faq.q: How long is a typical TVC?
faq.a: Common lengths are 10, 20, 30 and 60 seconds. We recommend one based on your message and media plan.

faq.q: Do you buy the airtime?
faq.a: We create the film and can advise on formats. Airtime is normally booked separately through a media buyer.

faq.q: Can the same film run on YouTube and social?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare resized and shortened cuts so it works across platforms.

faq.q: How is a TVC different from social video?
faq.a: A TVC is usually a polished broadcast-quality film built around one idea, while social video is more frequent, varied and platform-native.

faq.q: How much does a TV commercial cost to produce?
faq.a: Cost varies widely with the script, locations, cast, crew and edit. We scope after a creative discussion and share a production plan and budget.

faq.q: Do you handle script, shoot and edit?
faq.a: Yes. We develop the concept and script, plan the shoot, direct and film it, and complete the edit, sound and delivery.

faq.q: Can the TVC also run online?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver the main film plus cut-downs in the formats you need for YouTube, Instagram and other channels.
